title: Stonetop Follower (third-party content)
description: Frontmatter contract for a ready-made follower — a person, a band, or a beast a character can take on. Maps to Sled Dog's FollowerDef: adding one from the picker seeds a row on the character's Followers tab with these stats already filled in.

slug.description: kebab-case, no leading 'the-'. Sled Dog namespaces it (e.g. ext:<author>:<slug>).

name.description: Display name on the follower card and in the add picker.

summary.description: One or two sentences on who this is — shown in the picker and on the party's Manage content page.

type.description: Which colored label the follower carries: one person, a band (use `individuals` for its standouts), or a beast. Defaults to `individual`.

descriptor.description: The short line under the name — their look, their bearing, what they're known for.

loyalty.description: Starting Loyalty. Defaults to 1 when unset.

maxLoyalty.description: Loyalty track size. Defaults to 3 when unset.

instinct.description: What they do when left to themselves, e.g. "to settle it with fists".

cost.description: Their upkeep — what keeps them following, e.g. "drink", "a share of the take".

notes.description: Clarifying notes carried onto the follower's card (a bespoke move's text lives here for now).

individuals.description: Standout named members — group followers only.

tag.description: The one quality that sets them apart.

traits.description: Extra traits they've distinguished themselves with.

images.description: Optional images shipped to the party image gallery when this module is installed (a supporter feature). Files live beside this .md in the content repo; Sled Dog serves them from GitHub raw, pinned to the content commit.

file.description: Path to the image relative to this module folder (e.g. "art/homefront.png"). No leading slash, no "..".

caption.description: Short title shown on the gallery card.

description.description: Longer notes shown when the card is expanded.

url.description: A published Supabase public URL (paid packs). Alternative to `file`.

pack.description: For paid-pack content only: the pack slug this item belongs to.
